core_obligations: F_{U/X} is a universal homeomorphism by Varieties, Lemma relative-frobenius.
F_{U/X} is etale as a morphism between schemes etale over X (Morphisms, Lemma etale-permanence).
Hence F_{U/X} is an isomorphism by Theorem etale-radicial-open (universally injective + etale = open immersion; here also surjective).
proof_roadmap: Cite the universal-homeomorphism property of relative Frobenius; etale-permanence under composition with etale morphisms; conclude by the radicial-open theorem of this chapter.
difficulty_reason: Three-step chain, each step a citation or an in-chapter theorem: universal homeomorphism (Varieties), etale permanence (Morphisms), radicial + etale => isomorphism (in-chapter).
